channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: Ferrari's First Electric Car Is a Four-Door Designed by the Team Behind the iPhone
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric CARS
item.description: Ferrari unveiled the Luce in Rome: a 120 kWh, four-motor grand tourer built from scratch by Jony Ive and Marc Newson. Nothing was carried over from an existing model.

item.title: A California Startup Just Demonstrated 100 Hours of Grid Storage Using Tech From a Mars Mission
item.dc:creator: Undecided with Matt Ferrell
item.description: Noon Energy's carbon-air system stored energy for over 100 hours in a shipping-container-sized unit, using NASA-developed electrochemistry originally designed to make oxygen on Mars.

item.title: Toyota Hilux EV First Drive: 159 Miles of Range, But Still Passes Its Off-Road Brief
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: The electric Hilux has a 59.2 kWh battery and dual motors but drops towing from 3.5 tons to 1.6. Toyota says it's for urban fleets, not farm use, and the off-road test backed that framing up.

item.title: Rivian R1S After 7,000 Miles: Strong Software, Slow Charging, and Small Build Issues
item.dc:creator: Gjeebs
item.description: The 2026 R1S tri-motor is a genuine achievement at 2.9 seconds to 60 mph and 350 miles of range, but charging tops out at 215 kW and small build quality issues keep turning up.

item.title: Volkswagen CEO Calls This a Turning Point: Four New EVs, One Platform, Built in Spain
item.dc:creator: DW News
item.description: Oliver Blume marked production start of the ID Polo and Raval in Martorell. Three brands share one platform, with entry pricing targeting EUR 25,000 for the European volume market.

item.title: Battery-Powered Planes Are Already Flying Routes Across America
item.dc:creator: Good Morning America
item.description: Beta Technologies' all-electric aircraft charges for $13 and flies more than 300 miles on a single charge. UPS has ordered 150. Commercial freight operations begin in September.

item.title: Why Your Electric Bill Could Soon Be Negative
item.dc:creator: DW News
item.description: Solar overproduction is pushing wholesale electricity prices to zero. Smart meters and flexible tariffs let households charge cheaply and earn money selling power back to the grid.

item.title: Porsche Macan GTS Beats the Tesla Model Y Performance in a Drag Race
item.dc:creator: What Car?
item.description: Three electric sports SUVs, 250 miles, and one standing-kilometer drag race. The Porsche won the strip. The Tesla won the overall value argument. The Audi finished third.

item.title: Living in the $150K Pebble Flow Electric RV: First Real Camping Night
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: One night, two people, full AC in the heat, long showers, cooking, and a 74-mile tow. Real energy consumption numbers and honest verdict on what works and what does not.

item.title: Sodium Home Batteries Are Being Installed Right Now. Are They Better Than Lithium?
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric TECH
item.description: Salt-based batteries priced at parity with lithium, working at minus 20 degrees C without heaters, and discharging more fully per cycle. A UK startup is already fitting them in homes.

item.title: Wall-Mounted Solar Turns a South-Facing Brick Wall Into a £120/Year Profit
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric TECH
item.description: A UK homeowner's full retrofit reaches zero utility bills and earns £120 a year in grid export while charging two EVs. The wall solar array contributes 50 percent of total generation in winter.

item.title: GM's Hummer X Concept Is a Modular, Electric Off-Roader Designed to Be Taken Apart
item.dc:creator: CNET
item.description: GM reveals the Hummer X at its Pasadena advanced design facility: a fully electric truck with removable body panels, RFID pack-checking, and a design philosophy built around owner customization.

item.title: The Electrical Grid Is Being Rebuilt for AI, and Some Countries Are Not Ready
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg Originals
item.description: AI, EVs, and heat pumps are forcing the first major grid expansion in three decades. Bloomberg's Primer covers superconducting cables, Spain's blackout, and why China's grid advantage is a geopolitical problem.

item.title: 2026 Xiaomi SU7: Longer Range, 800V Charging, and Better Brakes Two Years In
item.dc:creator: EV.com
item.description: The updated SU7 moves to 800V architecture with up to 900V on Max trim, adds four-piston brake calipers, over 900 km CLTC range, and continuous damping control. 10 to 80 percent in 12 minutes.

item.title: Three Years With Two Tesla Powerwalls: Real Degradation, Real Savings
item.dc:creator: Zach Solar
item.description: After three years with a 10 kW system in Arizona, battery degradation sits at 6 percent and total annual energy cost — home plus two EVs — came to $1,937. The honest math on home solar storage.

item.title: Aboard T4: Self-Parking Electric Trailer With 200 kWh and a Tailgate Built for Living
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec BITS
item.description: A new entrant in the electric trailer space launches with 41 kWh LFP, a 40 kW tow-assist motor, app-controlled self-parking, auto-leveling jacks, a clamshell rear deck, and a combined power capacity of 200 kWh.

item.title: Real Cost of a 600 km Tesla Road Trip: Every Dollar Tracked
item.dc:creator: FrozenTesla
item.description: Two Supercharger stops, a free overnight hotel charge, and brutal prairie headwinds. Total: $36.49 CAD for a 600 km round trip. A Civic would have cost $86 CAD. A pickup truck, $168 CAD.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
